compiled:
📰 General

Putin Issues Stark Warning to US, Starlink Disruptions Plague Ukraine Conflict •

Vladimir Putin delivered a forceful message to US negotiators, stating that Russia would target any foreign troops operating within Ukraine. This escalation follows ongoing disruptions to Elon Musk’s Starlink satellite communication service, which the Ukrainian military relies on for vital communications. The disruptions are reportedly hindering Ukraine’s ability to coordinate defenses and respond to attacks. The Ukrainian military is struggling to maintain reliable communication channels amidst the ongoing conflict.

🌍 World

Greta Thunberg Reacts with Laughter to Continued ‘Fridays for Future’ Protests •

Greta Thunberg responded with hysterical laughter upon being informed that the Fridays for Future climate change group she established continued its regular protests. The revelation occurred while she was filming a documentary for the movement. The group, founded by Thunberg in 2018, has maintained a weekly demonstration on Fridays outside the Swedish parliament. This incident highlights the ongoing commitment of the organization to raising awareness about climate change.

🦅 US

Actress Lisa Maxwell’s Daughter Dies Suddenly at Columbia University – 27 Years Old •

Beau Jessup, the daughter of British actress Lisa Maxwell, passed away unexpectedly at Columbia University in New York City. The university confirmed her death via Instagram, stating she was pursuing an M.S. in Journalism. Jessup was 27 years old at the time of her death, and the cause of death has not yet been publicly released. The university extended its condolences to her family and friends.

💰 Business

Oprah’s Favorite Things Turns 30: Affordable Gifts for the Holiday Season •

Oprah’s Favorite Things is marking its 30th anniversary with a selection of gifts focused on comfort, creativity, and practicality. Adam Glassman, creative director of Oprah Daily, outlined the criteria for products featured on the list. The curated collection includes items ranging in price, offering consumers a variety of options for holiday shopping. The selection aims to provide accessible gifts for those seeking items that enhance daily life.

💻 Technology

Microsoft Investigates Widespread Outlook Issues Reported by Users •

Microsoft 365 is currently investigating reports of users experiencing difficulties accessing their Exchange Online mailboxes via Microsoft Outlook. The company confirmed receiving numerous error reports shortly after noon on Thursday. Initial investigations suggest the problem affects users accessing email through the Outlook application. Microsoft has not yet identified the root cause of the issue or provided an estimated timeframe for resolution.

🎭 Entertainment

Mike O’Malley Pays Tribute to ‘Yes, Dear’ Star Anthony Clark Following His Death •

Actor Anthony Clark, best known for his role in the sitcom “Yes, Dear,” has died at the age of 62. Former co-star Mike O’Malley shared photos of Clark on social media, recalling him as a “hilarious guy.” The news of Clark’s passing was announced by O’Malley, marking the end of an era for the beloved comedy series. Details surrounding Clark’s death have not yet been released publicly.

🏅 Sports

Steph Curry Defends Wife Ayesha Against Online Criticism, Highlighting Double Standards •

Steph Curry released a 90-second video addressing persistent online criticism directed at his wife, Ayesha Curry. The video, posted on Wardell Curry’s Instagram account, responded to trolls who have long targeted Ayesha for her opinions and lifestyle. Curry emphasized the unequal treatment Ayesha receives compared to male athletes and public figures. He argued that the sustained attacks represent a broader issue of double standards within the sports manosphere. The video aims to combat the negativity and highlight the scrutiny Ayesha faces.

🔬 Science

Strange Radio Signals From Distant Star System Detected Regularly •

Astronomers at the Parkes Observatory in Australia identified a star system emitting consistent radio pulses every eight minutes. The system, located 5,000 light-years away, consists of a binary star system – a white dwarf and a neutron star – orbiting each other. Scientists believe the pulses are generated by the neutron star as it periodically disrupts the magnetic field of the white dwarf. Further research is underway to determine the precise mechanism behind this unusual phenomenon.

🩺 Health

Man’s Secret Testosterone Use for Cows Linked to Severe Heart Failure •

A Massachusetts man suffered a decade-long decline in health, culminating in severe heart failure. Medical investigations revealed the man had been secretly administering synthetic testosterone to his herd of cows for eleven years. The testosterone, intended to increase milk production, caused significant cardiovascular strain and ultimately led to multiple hospitalizations and life support needs. Researchers identified elevated levels of the hormone in the man’s system as the primary cause of his heart failure. The case highlights the potential dangers of unauthorized hormone use and its impact on human health.
